mission: obi.ps1 L30 logic bug confirmation — STATE-SNAPSHOT staleness undetected for 16 runs

findings.logic_bug: Both snapshotRun and rssRun are loaded from STATE-SNAPSHOT.json. If both are stale but equal, equality check PASSES. Snapshot staleness is never compared to actual current run from git.
silent_failure_chain: stateStaleness not checked because equality already passed
L30 BOOT_FILE_AGE_SWEEP: silent no-op for 16 consecutive runs
findings.impact: All boot health checks since run 146 reported GREEN despite operating on 16-run-old state snapshot

verdict.fix_required: Replace equality check with comparison to actual current run from git log --grep '^death:' -1

negative_trails: L30 BOOT_FILE_AGE_SWEEP silent-failure confirmed in code
290.5 hours of stale state without detection
Any CI/automation relying on obi.ps1 doctor received false GREEN

evidence_chain.git_authority: L29 NO_ASSUME_HEAD -> git log --grep '^death:' -1 is authoritative
